description: The bar chart titled “Accuracy by different attributes on multi-retrieval task (n=2)” illustrates accuracy values for multiple models across five attribute types. The horizontal axis contains the model categories, labeled (left to right) “Qwen2.5-7b-1M,” “Internlm3-8b,” “ProLong-8b,” and “Qwen2.5-7b,” with labels angled; the vertical axis is a numeric accuracy scale on a linear axis ranging from 0 to 100 with tick marks at regular 20-point intervals. For each model, five adjacent (grouped) bars are shown, with colors mapped by the legend: “name” (teal), “hobby” (orange), “university” (blue), “major” (pink), and “birthdate” (light green). For Qwen2.5-7b-1M, the bars are approximately 92 (name), 90 (hobby), 87 (university), 95 (major), and 90 (birthdate). For Internlm3-8b, the bars are approximately 71 (name), 76 (hobby), 54 (university), 65 (major), and 89 (birthdate). For ProLong-8b, the bars are approximately 68 (name), 78 (hobby), 61 (university), 29 (major), and 85 (birthdate). For Qwen2.5-7b, the bars are near the bottom of the scale at approximately 3 (name), 4 (hobby), 2 (university), 4 (major), and 16 (birthdate). The bars are grouped by model with consistent color ordering within each group, there is no stacking, and the model categories appear in the displayed left-to-right order without an indicated sorting rule; no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding and the legend.
